notes: Phase 2 uses parent-approved neutral visual labels because most source rows do not expose official public names.
Classic light/dark files are modeled as variant fields on one preset row because the source describes them as variants for skin tones, not separate selectable presets.
Classic card images are generated as side-by-side local WebP composites when light and dark source files differ.
Custom Makeup parts are deduped by source image file across Feminine and Masculine menus, with availableIn recording shared visibility.
Custom Masculine source prose count conflicts with parsed table images; parsed images are used and the conflict remains recorded in research notes.
Raw source IDs and source/audit fields must remain hidden from public cards through the parent route override.
Parent route/config work is still required before this page can render at /wiki/dress-to-impress/makeup.
